messages:
mia (Partner Eng): Heads-up — partner CI flagged a performance regression that lines up with driver 24.1 + CUDA 12.2 when using quantized kernels. They see a ~20% latency bump and a couple of kernel OOMs, probably ABI/selection fallout.
aj (HW Partner): Seeing the same in our nightly: two failing tests in matrix_mul_sanity, stack trace points at matmul_kernel_v2. Log snippet: `E matmul_kernel_v2: launch failed code=9` — looks like a mismatched kernel path.
sofia (Marketplace): Are marketplace AMIs currently pinned? Last bake used driver 23.7. If partners want to pin back we need a clear bake + tag plan so customers don't get surprise changes.
kevin (Runtime Eng): Reproduced locally on an A100 with CUDA12.2 + 8-bit quant profile. The runtime picks the new matmul path with 24.1 driver; fallback to legacy kernel succeeds and latency returns to normal. I can add a kernel-selector fallback switch while we investigate.
olivia (PM): We need an operational plan + partner comms. Can we get a hotfix that restores previous selector behavior and a marketplace canary image? Also want a timeline for partner-facing note and joint announcement (if any).
mia (Partner Eng): Proposed plan: 1) branch hotfix to restore old kernel selector behavior (24.1.1) 2) build a canary marketplace image pinned to driver 23.7 and label as `edge-driver-23-7` 3) run partner CI matrix + dedicated canaries 4) if green, bake stable marketplace AMI and publish rollback guidance. Target: hotfix + canary image in 48h, stable bake in 72h.
aj (HW Partner): I'll escalate with the HW partner PM and run their 48-case regression matrix tonight. For clarity we should pin to `driver=23.7.2` + `cuda=12.1.*` for the canary. Confirm?
kevin (Runtime Eng): Confirm. I'll open PR runtime#987 with: - fallback toggle `rc.allow_legacy_kernels` (default false) - canary flag `rc.kernel_selector_canary=true` and add CI test that exercises both paths. I'll aim to have CI green within 6–8h.
sofia (Marketplace): Marketplace ops: we can push an `edge` track image tagged `marketplace/redwood-inference:edge-driver-23-7-<sha>` and schedule a limited bake to 5% of customers in the EU region. Need legal/partner sign-off if this affects managed partner fleets.
deploy-bot: Scheduled marketplace-image-bake for `marketplace/redwood-inference:edge-driver-23-7` at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Notification will go to #eng-releases when bake completes.
mia (Partner Eng): Action items recap: - aj -> confirm partner CI matrix results by EOD - kevin -> open PR + run runtime CI - sofia -> create edge image + coordinate bake + prepare packaging notes - olivia -> draft partner comms (embargoed) + schedule partner sync. I'll set a cross-org sync 16:00 PT today. :calendar:
olivia (PM): Added the sync to calendars. Quick rollback playbook draft for partner ops:
```rollback playbook:
1) switch routing to driver=23.7 pool (traffic split 100% -> 23.7)
2) set `rc.allow_legacy_kernels=true` on runtime agents
3) re-run smoke tests (latency, throughput, basic evals)
4) monitor errors for 1h; if failures >5% open incident and escalate to partners
5) start coordinated customer notice if rollback prolonged >4h
``` 
kevin (Runtime Eng): I'll include a smoke test that checks quantized inference for the failing model and a perf baseline. Adding perf thresholds to the CI job.
aj (HW Partner): Partner confirmed they'll run the matrix and share logs into the shared bucket (s3://partner-regressions/2291234567). Expect results by 22:00 PT.
sofia (Marketplace): I'll draft the packaging notes and a short README explaining the driver pin tag and a migration note for customers that manually manage drivers.
mia (Partner Eng): Thanks team. If CI looks good tonight we'll ship the canary tomorrow and loop in partner PMs. If anything is blocking, drop it here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
